principles.statement: Business capabilities own their data and expose governed contracts.
principles.rationale: Avoid hidden coupling to private storage and preserve accountable ownership.

principles.statement: Consequential AI access crosses an enterprise control boundary.
principles.rationale: Central policy, audit, residency, and model controls must remain independently enforceable.

principles.statement: Architecture evidence is revision-bound and independently derived.
principles.rationale: Candidate-authored declarations cannot prove their own conformance.
